planariumview.config.title: Planarium Panorama
planariumview.config.radius.tooltip: Radius around the Planarium for block updates, animations, particles and sounds. Blocks appear 32 times bigger.
planariumview.config.far_radius.tooltip:
Maximum scenery distance around the Planarium. Beyond the %1$s, only a snapshot of the blocks is shown.

While the Planarium is moving, the scenery updates as you travel.

OFF: the scenery ends at the %1$s.
planariumview.config.neighbors.tooltip:
Shows the interiors of up to this many Planariums within the %s, nearest first.

Blocks and lighting captured when you enter the jar, without chests, mobs or particles.

On a Sable structure, only Planariums on that same structure are shown.
planariumview.config.refresh.tooltip:
Regularly refreshes all scenery, within the %1$s and beyond. Also updates paintings, item frames and armor stands.

If %2$s and this option are both OFF, the scenery stays as captured when you entered the jar.
planariumview.config.fog.tooltip:
How far the scenery remains visible before fading into fog.

OFF: no fog.

Scenery edge: fog hides the outer edge of the scenery.

Render distance: uses Minecraft's render distance. The snapshot beyond the %s is not shown.
planariumview.config.lighting.tooltip:
How light works in the jar.

OFF: same as Ars Nouveau. Everything is fully lit, with no shadows (the giant scenery like the miniature).

Sky and scenery: the jar shows the outside sky and time of day. The giant scenery and the miniature are lit like the real place. The inside of the jar (your blocks, you) stays fully lit.

Full: same as Sky and scenery, and the inside of the jar is also lit like the Planarium's spot outside: darker at night, dark in a cave, lit by the torches next to it (with their color).
planariumview.config.biome.tooltip: The scenery and the jar take on the real biomes around the Planarium: grass, leaves and water colors, and inside the jar the biome's music, ambient sounds and particles.
planariumview.config.ambience.tooltip:
Plays Dynamic Surroundings ambience for the Planarium's outside location, including biome and cave sounds.

Also applies its biome fog colors inside the jar. With %s enabled, its fireflies appear around flowers in the scenery and miniatures.
planariumview.config.server_controlled: Set by the server you are playing on.
planariumview.config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. OFF: everything is like in Ars Nouveau (no giant scenery, black sky, Ars lighting). Your other choices are kept.
planariumview.config.weather.tooltip: Outside rain, snow and lightning: rain and snow fall on the scenery with the rain sound, you hear the thunder and see nearby bolts.
planariumview.config.clouds.tooltip: Outside clouds show up in the jar when the Planarium is close to the cloud layer, giant like the scenery. Follows the Clouds video setting.
planariumview.config.clouds.other_mod: %s is installed: the clouds in the jar will be vanilla clouds, unlike the ones outside. Turn this off if you prefer no clouds in the jar.
planariumview.config.reenter: Some changes only fully apply after leaving and re-entering the jar.
planariumview.config.block_updates.toolt:
Maximum time for block changes within the %1$s to appear in the scenery.

Shorter delays increase server load in active areas (farms, redstone...).

OFF: changes wait for the %2$s.
planariumview.config.ambient_sounds.tool: Plays AmbientSounds ambience inside the jar based on where the Planarium is: dimension, biome, weather, height and nearby blocks.
planariumview.config.scenery_particles.t:
Shows smoke, flames, drips and other particles from scenery blocks, plus outside explosions.

Particles follow the scale of each view: 32 times larger in the giant scenery and 32 times smaller in miniatures.

Follows Minecraft's %s setting: fewer with Decreased, none with Minimal.
planariumview.config.scenery_ambience.to:
Sounds made by blocks in the scenery: flowing water, fire, lava, portals and campfires. They come from the blocks' direction.

These sounds can play even when the outside area is inactive.
planariumview.config.world_sounds.toolti:
Hear events around the Planarium: mobs, redstone, explosions and jukeboxes, from their direction in the scenery. Mobs are only heard while Outside mobs is ON.

Sounds directly caused by players are not relayed.
planariumview.config.outside_vehicles.to:
Show boats, rafts and minecarts moving in the detail radius of the giant scenery. Independent of %s: mob passengers appear when both options are ON.

Up to 64 mobs and vehicles combined, nearest first.
planariumview.config.outside_vehicles.wa: ON: keeps the area within the %s and a small surrounding margin active so vehicles move, even with outside world sounds OFF. Server load depends on the mobs and machines present.
planariumview.config.miniature_mobs.tool:
Shows the mobs of the jar in its miniature, 32 times smaller like its blocks, with small idle animations (breathing, wings, looking around). Up to 4 miniatures within 8 blocks, with at most 64 mobs each.

The mobs stay at their last known positions. These copies do not keep the pocket running.
planariumview.config.outside_mobs.toolti:
Show mobs moving in the detail radius of the giant scenery (up to 64 mobs and vehicles combined, nearest first). Mob passengers in boats or minecarts also require Outside vehicles.

OFF: mobs are not shown or heard, even with %s ON.
planariumview.config.outside_mobs.warnin: ON: keeps the area within the %s and a small surrounding margin simulated so mobs move, even with outside world sounds OFF. Server load depends on the mobs and machines there.
planariumview.config.world_sounds.warnin:
ON: keeps the area within the %1$s active, so machines, mobs and furnaces continue running.

OFF: no longer keeps that area active, unless Outside mobs or Outside vehicles is ON. %2$s can still play.
planariumview.config.cave_fog.tooltip:
Fog color around the scenery when the Planarium is in a closed cave.

Vanilla: the fog color of the Planarium's biome, darker at night and in the rain, like vanilla caves.

Dark: black, only deep in a cave with no view of the outside at all. Elsewhere in a cave, the Vanilla color is used.

A biome with its own fog color (like Alex's Caves biomes) always keeps that color.
planariumview.config.reset.tooltip: Puts every option back to its default value. It is saved right away: it can't be undone.
planariumview.config.sub_levels.tooltip:
Show Sable structures in the giant scenery and miniature.

OFF: they are no longer drawn or captured for you. If the Planarium is on a moving structure, the scenery still follows its movement.

If ships do not reappear after switching this back ON, leave and rejoin the world.
planariumview.config.lunar_events.toolti: The jar's moon follows the lunar event of the Planarium's world: blood moon, blue moon, harvest moon... (moon color, size and texture, and the tint of the light). Needs the synced sky (Lighting not OFF).
